alex_support: Hi team — Customer (maya_customer) reports Dedicated dashboard showing only a few nodes/GPU rows for cluster 'prod-eu-2' after we ran a node relabel + drain last night. They see empty/missing rows for several nodepools.
maya_customer: yep, after we relabeled nodepool keys the panel goes blank except for the control plane nodes. No API errors on our side, but the GPU counts are zero for most pools.
alex_support: Thanks @maya_customer — can you confirm the relabel script used key 'pool' instead of 'nodepool'? any outputs you can paste?
maya_customer: script output:
```
kubectl label node node-3 pool=ai-gpu --overwrite
kubectl label node node-4 pool=ai-gpu --overwrite
```
we used 'pool' by accident, old label was 'nodepool'
jonah_platform: tagging @lina_sre — likely a selector mismatch in telemetry/ingest. The inventory service expects label `nodepool` to attribute GPUs to pools.
sre-bot: Inventory sync job (job-id: inv-sync-202) reported 3 warnings: missing label matches for 8 nodes in cluster prod-eu-2. See /internal/logs/inv-sync-202.
lina_sre: On it. Quick checks: is telemetry exporter filtering by label key? Also check cache TTL for the dashboard panels — might be serving stale zero counts.
alex_support: Repro steps requested by customer: 1) relabel a node to 'pool=ai-gpu' 2) drain and cordon 3) wait 2m 4) open /dedicated/capacity panel -> see missing rows. They did this live.
lina_sre: I ran similar locally against staging. Confirmed: inventory service list_by_label('nodepool') returns only nodes still using old key. When labels change to 'pool' the k8s watcher emits events but the label key used by the exporter wasn't updated; exporter code uses `node.metadata.labels['nodepool']`.
jonah_platform: That explains missing rows — dashboard queries per-nodepool by that label and then aggregates gpu_count. Two leads to fix: 1) add backward-compat relabeling in exporter to read both keys, 2) run a one-off resync to repopulate Redis cache.
lina_sre: For immediate mitigation I pushed a small patch to telemetry-exporter to fall back to `pool` if `nodepool` missing, and restarted the exporter in prod-eu-2.
alex_support: Patch deployed? any risk to other regions?
lina_sre: Deployed to prod-eu-2 only (canary) — low risk. Restarted: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/telemetry-exporter -n infra`. After restart exporter reported nodes with pool values.
sre-bot: Deploy completed: telemetry-exporter prod-eu-2 canary -> SUCCESS. 2 replicas restarted.
lina_sre: After restart, triggered inv-sync (manual): `POST /internal/inventory/resync?cluster=prod-eu-2` -> job inv-sync-203 queued.
alex_support: Customer confirmation?
maya_customer: Confirmed: dashboard now shows rows for ai-gpu and counts match. Thank you! :tada:
jonah_platform: Root cause: relabel script used new key 'pool' without updating exporter/queries. Fixes: (1) exporter fallback (PR#4281), (2) inventory service to accept multiple label keys in selector (follow-up), (3) add unit/regression test for label-key regressions.
lina_sre: Follow-up tasks I've created: ENGINFRA-876 (expand label selectors), ENGINFRA-877 (add regression test), and OPS-424 (backfill any clusters with mixed keys). Also adding a dashboard note that relabel runs can cause transient inventory gaps and to trigger resync.
alex_support: I'll reply to customer with the workaround steps and link to the incident tickets. Closing help escalations after customer ack. :white_check_mark:
